statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if, for every row index i with 0 <= i < m and every column index j with 0 <= j < n: if i is even then mat[i][(j + k) mod n] = mat[i][j], and if i is odd then mat[i][(j - k) mod n] = mat[i][j], where 'mod n' denotes the least non-negative residue modulo n. Equivalently, r = true exactly when the matrix obtained by performing k rounds (each even-indexed row shifted cyclically left by one per round and each odd-indexed row shifted cyclically right by one per round) is identical to mat.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). Assume 1 <= m <= 25; every row of mat has length n with 1 <= n <= 25; 1 <= k <= 50; and 1 <= mat[i][j] <= 25 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n.
